MSNBC Spokane Gives Us More Prohibitionist Propaganda:
"Marijuana has become more potent over the years."

By Beverly Carr
(Marijuananews note: Carr is the same reporter who gave us
Mfiles Announced On Local MSNBC In Pure Party Line "Journalism"
Apparently, MSNBC in Spokane has no journalistic standards at all.)

SPOKANE, February 28 - Marijuana has become more potent over the years. In Spokane, police say it’s as popular as ever.

Last week, Sheriff’s deputies raided a grass growing operation and arrested two people, but say that’s a drop in the bucket.

Lt. Chan Bailey says part of the problem - is the potency. "In the 70s, the THC levels were normally around one or two percent, and now it’s common to see them around 10 percent, and now an extremely well-taken-care-of plant may approach 20-percent THC." THC is the high-inducing chemical in marijuana, and it means users tend to get a better high from fewer smokes. Bailey says that’s one reason for the increasing popularity.

Authorities are trying to control the growth in use, however, through education, drug abuse programs and proper punishment.

"We can keep our fingers in the dyke and keep it from getting worse. I think we’ll have up and downs, and I think Spokane is in an upswing in drug abuse and drug problems," he says.
(Marijuananews note: Notice that "marijuana" equals "drug abuse." Of course, there are some marijuana stories that MSNBC Spokane may not report.)
